title: Helsinki STOP NATO demonstration / flash-mob reported for 28 January
location: By the U.S. Embassy, Helsinki, as reported by FI-S005
scope: One local Helsinki action described by FI-S005; no wider or multi-site scope established
threshold_50_evidence: The roughly ten-person estimate from FI-S005 is below 50 if accurate. FI-S003 reports a late-January Helsinki anti-NATO demonstration but gives no attendance. The estimate has not been independently corroborated; eligibility remains pending threshold evidence.

start_date.summary: FI-S005 reports the flash-mob occurred on 28 January. FI-S003 dates a Helsinki anti-NATO demonstration only to the week before its 31 January publication and does not independently establish 28 January.

location.summary: FI-S005 places the reported flash-mob by the U.S. Embassy in Helsinki; FI-S004’s search-result title gives the same general location. FI-S004 is unread and is not independent confirmation.

scope.summary: The report describes a Helsinki flash-mob; no national or multi-city action is established.

organizer.summary: FI-S005 names Suomen Patriootit. FI-S004’s title names a similarly described Suomen patriootit action; exact organization identity and source independence are not resolved.

demands.summary: FI-S005 describes opposition to Finland’s NATO membership and U.S. presence. A Finnish policy demand is reported, but its wording and separation from the foreign U.S.-presence target need independent confirmation.

participants_original.summary: FI-S005 reports roughly ten protesters; no second source supplies a count.

participants_point_estimate.summary: The source’s rounded estimate is about ten, retained as an attributed approximate point estimate, not an exact count or range.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: FI-S005’s about-ten estimate falls below 50 if accurate; FI-S003 gives no count. The only estimate is uncorroborated.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown. The accessed reports do not establish event-specific protester violence or an explicit absence.

state_response.summary: Unknown. FI-S003 describes police contacting the organizer about a proposed Quran burning that was abandoned; FI-S005 describes police warning a journalist. Neither establishes a response to the event’s political demand or any listed response category.

notes: Research candidate only; ccode 375 remains provisional and no official MM ID is assigned. FI-S003 and FI-S005 may describe the same event because both concern a late-January Helsinki anti-NATO gathering and planned Quran burning, but FI-S003 does not identify the date and the match is not proven. FI-S004 is a related search-only advocacy headline, not independent corroboration. The reported crowd is roughly ten in FI-S005; do not treat the case as meeting the 50-person rule without new evidence.
open_questions: Seek an independent contemporaneous attendance estimate or an authoritative count; retain the reported approximate wording unless better evidence appears.
Determine whether FI-S003 describes the 28 January event in FI-S005 or a separate Helsinki gathering.
Clarify whether the reported opposition to Finland’s NATO membership was an explicit demand on Finnish authorities, apart from opposition to U.S. presence.
Establish actual start/end times and any event-specific state response; distinguish police contact about the proposed Quran burning and warning to a journalist from response to the protest demand.
